Virtual Reality Adventure

Walk through dinosaur canyons, bounce across glowing mushroom caps, slide on a frozen aurora lake and moon-jump across a lunar base. Play free on your phone, your computer or your VR headset.

Works in Chrome, Edge, Safari and Firefox. VR mode runs in the Meta Quest browser.

How to play

Find the gems. Unlock the worlds. Hunt the relics.

Every world hides 12 glowing gems, each marked by a tall beam of light, plus one golden legendary relic. The compass at the top always points to the nearest gem, and the radar shows everything around you. Collect gems to unlock new worlds. Your progress saves automatically on this device.

Computer

  • W A S D or arrow keys to move, Space jump, Shift sprint
  • Click and drag to spin the camera 360 around Coburn. Scroll, or pinch your trackpad, to zoom. Q E rotate, V switches first and third person
  • M worlds menu, H back to Basecamp, C chat with Coburn
  • Game controllers work too: left stick moves, right stick looks, A jumps

Phone, tablet and touchscreen

  • Touch and drag on the left side to walk, drag on the right side to spin the camera, pinch with two fingers to zoom. Touchscreen laptops work the same way.
  • Tap JUMP to jump and RUN to toggle sprinting. Landscape gives you the biggest view.

VR headset

  • Open this site in your headset browser (Meta Quest works great) and tap Enter VR
  • Left stick walks where you look, right stick snap-turns, A or trigger jumps, grip sprints
  • Clear a safe space around you and take breaks. Keep the comfort vignette on if you feel woozy.

The worlds

  • Whispering Wildwood: a golden forest with a hidden lake, deer, foxes, stags and curious wolves
  • Emberhold Village: a sunset medieval town with an inn, windmill, market square and bonfires
  • Dino Canyon: red rock cliffs, a jungle river, a smoking volcano and real dinosaurs
  • Glowshroom Hollow: a neon night valley of giant glowing mushrooms and bounce pads
  • Frostfang Peaks: snowy mountains under the northern lights, a frozen lake and friendly yetis
  • Skyreach Islands: floating islands above a sea of clouds with sky-high launch pads
  • Star Rover Moon: a low-gravity moon base under a giant planet, with patrol drones and a huge mech
